The '''2022–23 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Texas Christian University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by seventh-year head coach [[Jamie Dixon]], and played their home games at [[Schollmaier Arena]] in [[Fort Worth, Texas]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 22–13, 9–9 in [[2022–23 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 Play]] to finish in a tie for 5th place. They defeated [[2022–23 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 Tournament]] before losing to [[2022–23 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] where they defeated [[2022–23 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round to [[2022–23 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]].

==Previous season==
The [[2021–22 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|Horned Frogs]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 21–13, 8–10 in [[2021–22 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in fifth place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2022 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Texas]] in the quarterfinals, before losing to [[2021–22 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the South Region, where they defeated [[2021–22 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the first round before losing to [[2021–22 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] in the second round in an overtime thriller. There is a small controversy regarding the final play in regular time during the game versus Arizona. Mike Miles Jr. looked like he had been fouled but the foul was not called. However, Miles could have attempted the free throw shots since there was a bonus. These shots would have sealed the game for a victory against Arizona.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Arizona vs. TCU men's NCAA Tournament basketball game marred by controversial no-call late |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/ncaabk/arizona-vs-tcu-mens-ncaa-tournament-basketball-game-marred-by-controversial-no-call-late/ar-AAVkdYV |access-date=2022-03-25 |website=MSN |language=en-US}}</ref>

With their win over Seton Hall in the first round, the Horned Frogs won their first [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] game since 1987.
